description: The Register of Infrastructure (RINF) is the EU register of the characteristics and capabilities of the static railway network: for every operational point (such as stations, junctions and border points) and section of line it records the values of the network parameters set by the common specifications, with data validity dates, and lets users view each point or section in detail, list those on a user-defined route, and run a Route Compatibility Check of whether a vehicle can run between two operational points. Each Member State must publish its register under Directive (EU) 2016/797, compiled by a national registration entity from infrastructure manager files, and the European Union Agency for Railways runs the web application as single entry point under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/777. Coverage is the EU Member States and associated countries at the level of operational points and sections of lines. Data are exchanged as XML against the RINF XSD schema with a look-up value table and application guide 3.1.0; searches and exports in several formats are free after self-registration and acceptance of the RINF terms of use, and a list of border points is a direct CSV download. Caveats: the quality depends on national submissions, and exports for route compatibility need certificates. RINF supplies rail network topology and capacity attributes for network flow, capacity planning and interoperability studies, and relates to the ERA vocabulary and knowledge graph and to the railML exchange format catalogued here.
